messages:
Alice: heads-up: promo for v2.12.0 is blocked in the 09:30 UTC window. deploy-bot failed the image-extract step on several runners (checksum mismatch while unpacking cache). Anyone?
Bob: saw it too. runners report layer checksum mismatch on unpack: "checksum mismatch: expected sha256:aa11.. got sha256:ff99.."
DeployBot: Automated Alert - promo auto-hold
  promo-id: 9921
  failed-step: image-extract
  affected-runners: us-west-2-*, eu-west-*
infra-bot: Observability - cache-service reported object-read errors and client-side retries between 1758004200-1758004300. S3 200 with bad content-length observed on 3 nodes.
Carol: could be edge cache corruption. Is the registry value for that layer matching the builder artifact?
Alice: registry shows expected sha256:aa11... but several runners streamed a different blob hash. Builder upload logged success.
Bob: options: 1) manual-promote previous safe tag (v2.11.9) 2) force reupload the offending layer from builder host (fast, risk of partial copy) 3) rebuild+upload new image (safe, may miss window) 4) abort window.
release-bot: Suggested action: pin to previous tag + create follow-up ticket for cache-service. Use `/releasebot manual-promote 9921 --pin v2.11.9 --lock 45m` if approved.
Alice: +1 pin-old. Add entry to release_notes: "Canary pinned to v2.11.9 due to transient cache-layer corruption during extract; rebuild scheduled."
Carol: creating ticket INF-1598 for cache-service read-path. I'll attach logs and runner hashes.
Bob: I'll start a forced reupload from build node in parallel and report back. If reupload verifies, we can unpin and retry within window.
DeployBot: Manual promote request created: PR-9006; status: awaiting approval.
Alice: approved. Mike (release lead) please click approve in PR so we can keep the change window.
Bob: reupload completed; registry now serves verified blob (sha256:aa11...). infra-bot: no new read errors in last 3 mins.
Alice: great. If promotion still blocked we'll retry full promo path; otherwise release-bot to proceed with pinned promote.
